name: PWS - Pirate Weather Station
description: TV-style weather channels powered by the Pirate Weather API. Runs up to three stations, each with its own location and Dispatcharr channel.
author: dexdeadly

fields.label: Setup
fields.description: Create a free API key at pirateweather.net, subscribe to the Forecast API, then enter the key and at least one ZIP code below. Activation of a new key can take up to 20 minutes. Each enabled station becomes its own channel.

fields.label: Pirate Weather API Key
fields.help_text: Required. Shared by every station and kept out of the command line.

fields.label: Units
fields.help_text: Unit system used for all on-screen values.

fields.label: Resolution
fields.help_text: Output resolution for every station.

fields.label: Video Bitrate (kbps)
fields.help_text: Target video bitrate per station.

fields.label: Data Refresh Interval (minutes)
fields.help_text: How often each station re-polls Pirate Weather for a forecast. Automatically multiplied by the number of enabled stations (2 stations = 2x this interval, 3 = 3x, ...) so the total monthly call count stays the same no matter how many stations run. The default of 10 minutes keeps even 3 stations comfortably under the free tier's 10,000 calls/month; the 5-minute floor is the lowest value that still holds true at 3 stations.

fields.label: Radar Source
fields.help_text: Pirate Weather serves no radar imagery, so radar comes from a separate provider. NOAA covers the US only; RainViewer is worldwide. The on-screen credit follows whichever is used.

fields.label: Background Music Volume
fields.help_text: 0 disables music. NOTE: no audio ships with the plugin - drop your own .mp3/.m4a/.aac/.flac/.ogg/.wav files into the plugin's assets/music folder, then restart. One is chosen at random and looped for the run. pws.log records which track was picked.

fields.label: News Ticker Feeds
fields.help_text: Optional RSS/Atom URLs, comma separated, shared by every station. Weather alerts always appear in the ticker regardless.

fields.label: Enable Station 1
fields.help_text: Each enabled station runs its own renderer and channel. Refresh intervals are shared out between them so the monthly API quota stays the same no matter how many you run.

fields.label: Station 1 ZIP Code
fields.help_text: 5-digit US ZIP used to locate the forecast. Leave blank and set Latitude/Longitude instead for locations outside the US.

fields.label: Station 1 Latitude
fields.help_text: Decimal degrees (e.g. 51.5074). Used instead of ZIP Code for locations outside the US; ignored when a ZIP Code is set.

fields.label: Station 1 Longitude
fields.help_text: Decimal degrees, negative for west (e.g. -0.1278).

fields.label: Station 1 Location Name
fields.help_text: Optional on-screen name. Resolved automatically from the ZIP or Latitude/Longitude if blank.

fields.label: Station 1 Surf Spot Coordinates
fields.help_text: Optional. Latitude, longitude of a surf break (e.g. 33.6553, -118.0029), separate from the forecast location. Adds a Surf Report page with waves, swell, wind, water temperature and tides (tides: US coasts only). Leave blank to hide the page.

fields.label: Station 1 Surf Spot Name
fields.help_text: Optional on-screen name for the surf spot (e.g. Huntington Pier).

fields.label: Station 1 Channel Number
fields.help_text: Optional channel number. Auto-assigned when blank.

actions.label: Start
actions.description: Launch the PWS renderer and publish the channel.

confirm.title: Stop PWS?
confirm.message: This will terminate the running PWS feed.

actions.label: Reset to Defaults
actions.description: Stop the renderer and restore default settings.

confirm.title: Reset PWS settings?
confirm.message: This stops the renderer and restores every setting to its default, including the API key.
